arxiv-2506-00615.creator: Andreu Ballús Santacana
arxiv-2506-00615.description: Abstract We present a tractable, incremental framework for topological dialogue semantics based on finite, discrete semantic spaces. A systematic review was conducted in accordance with Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines.
